KPI Catalog.requirements_alignment: Metric row 1: Gross Tax paid per store
KPI Catalog.plain_english_definition: Total tax amount associated with store sales for each store and reporting period.
KPI Catalog.calculation_logic: For each store and period, sum order_total from raw_orders and multiply by the store tax_rate from raw_stores. Use tax_paid as a validation field where available.
KPI Catalog.numerator_logic: sum(cast(raw_orders.order_total as numeric)) * cast(raw_stores.tax_rate as numeric)
KPI Catalog.required_columns: raw_orders.store_id, raw_orders.order_total, raw_orders.tax_paid, raw_orders.ordered_at, raw_stores.id, raw_stores.name, raw_stores.tax_rate
KPI Catalog.filters_conditions: Filter by order date, store name, week, and month.
KPI Catalog.grain: one row per store per order date
KPI Catalog.time_grain: daily base grain with week and month rollups
KPI Catalog.open_questions: Confirm whether reported tax should use calculated order_total * tax_rate or the raw tax_paid column when the two differ.

KPI Catalog.requirements_alignment: Metric row 2: Gross revenue generated per store
KPI Catalog.plain_english_definition: Total order value generated by each store.
KPI Catalog.calculation_logic: Sum order_total from raw_orders for each store and reporting period after joining raw_orders.store_id to raw_stores.id.
KPI Catalog.filters_conditions: Filter by order date, store name, week, and month.
KPI Catalog.grain: one row per store per order date

Dashboard Outputs.decision_supported: Understand store revenue and tax trends by day, week, and month.
Dashboard Outputs.cadence: Daily revenue monitoring with monthly tax reporting.
Dashboard Outputs.required_filters: Store Name, Order Date, Week, Month
Dashboard Outputs.required_drilldowns: Month → Week → Order Date → Store Name
Dashboard Outputs.notes: Customer-level, product-level, and net-profit goals are not represented in the current Metrics tab and remain out of scope for this build.

Charts & Visuals.grain_needed: store and day, aggregatable to selected period

Charts & Visuals.visual_title: Tax paid by store and week
Charts & Visuals.default_time_window: Most recent month after dashboard filter is applied
Charts & Visuals.grain_needed: store and day, aggregatable to store and week
Charts & Visuals.notes: Uses calculated tax by default and includes raw tax_paid for validation.

Filters & Drilldowns.label: Store Name
Filters & Drilldowns.allowed_values_logic: Distinct non-null store_name values from joined store records.

Open Questions.question: Should the final tax metric use calculated tax from order_total and tax_rate, or sum the raw tax_paid column?
Open Questions.why_it_matters: The dashboard number may differ if raw tax_paid reflects discounts, rounding, or historical tax changes.
Open Questions.suggested_default: Use calculated tax for the KPI and expose raw tax_paid as a validation column.

Open Questions.question: Should customer, product, and net-profit goals be added as concrete metrics later?
Open Questions.why_it_matters: They are mentioned in the engagement context but not defined in the Metrics tab.
Open Questions.suggested_default: Keep them out of scope until metric definitions and source columns are supplied.
